# spider1 — a native PC port of the PSX Spider-Man (SLUS_008.75, USA), built on the psxport
# framework (external/psxport).
#
# The framework (PSX-generic static-recomp substrate + runtime + HW backends + SBS harness + the
# native renderer) is the reusable `psxport` library. This repo adds the game seam (game/**) and the
# recompiled SLUS_008.75 substrate (generated/**, regenerated by run.sh / tools/ensure_recomp.py),
# and links libpsxport.
#
# No disc image, executable, or asset from the game is committed here — supply your own.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(spider1 CXX C)

# PSXPORT_DIR — WHERE THE FRAMEWORK SOURCE COMES FROM. Defaults to external/psxport, which is no
# longer a git submodule (2026-08-16): tools/psxport_sync.py --auto (called by run.sh) makes it a
# SYMLINK to the workspace's shared framework clone when one exists, or a private clone at this
# repo's psxport.pin on a fresh machine. So a fresh clone of this repo alone still builds
# standalone: that property is what "each game is its own project using psxport as the framework"
# means, and it must stay testable.
#
# Point it at a specific framework checkout to build against in-progress framework work:
#
#   cmake -S . -B build -DPSXPORT_DIR=$HOME/repo/psx/psxport
#
# It is a CACHE path, so it survives reconfigures, and `run.sh` passes it through from the
# environment. Everything else in this file and in cmake/ derives from it — never re-spell
# `external/psxport` at a call site, or the two halves of a build can come from different checkouts.
set(PSXPORT_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/external/psxport" CACHE PATH
    "psxport framework source directory (default: external/psxport)")
if(NOT EXISTS "${PSXPORT_DIR}/cmake/psxport.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "PSXPORT_DIR=${PSXPORT_DIR} has no cmake/psxport.cmake — "
                      "run `python3 tools/psxport_sync.py --auto`, or point PSXPORT_DIR at a psxport checkout.")
endif()
message(STATUS "psxport framework: ${PSXPORT_DIR}")

# RECORD WHAT THIS CONFIGURE RESOLVED, so `tools/psxport_sync.py --check` can compare the framework
# you actually BUILT against with the one psxport.pin RECORDS. The framework is no longer a git
# submodule (external/psxport is a symlink to the workspace's shared clone, or a private clone at the
# pin — see tools/psxport_sync.py); the pin is provenance, and this file is what keeps it honest.
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${PSXPORT_DIR}" rev-parse HEAD
                OUTPUT_VARIABLE PSXPORT_RESOLVED_SHA OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
                ERROR_QUIET RESULT_VARIABLE _psxport_rev_rc)
if(NOT _psxport_rev_rc EQUAL 0)
  set(PSXPORT_RESOLVED_SHA "unknown")   # honest: never silently record a plausible-looking sha
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/psxport_resolved.txt"
     "dir = ${PSXPORT_DIR}\ncommit = ${PSXPORT_RESOLVED_SHA}\n")
message(STATUS "psxport commit: ${PSXPORT_RESOLVED_SHA}")


set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
endif()

find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
find_package(zstd CONFIG QUIET)
if(NOT TARGET zstd::libzstd_shared)
  find_library(ZSTD_LIBRARY zstd REQUIRED)
  add_library(zstd::libzstd_shared SHARED IMPORTED)
  set_target_properties(zstd::libzstd_shared PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${ZSTD_LIBRARY}")
endif()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED COMPONENTS Crypto)

# libchdr (CHD access) comes from the Beetle PSX submodule NESTED under the psxport submodule.
add_subdirectory(${PSXPORT_DIR}/vendor/beetle-psx/deps/libchdr
                 ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libchdr_build EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# The framework is configured once. Each selected title contributes one derived runtime and one
# generated substrate; no executable links two substrates whose address-derived symbols collide.
include(${PSXPORT_DIR}/cmake/psxport.cmake)
include(cmake/title_manifest.cmake)
set(SPIDER_TITLES "spiderman1" CACHE STRING "Spider title targets to configure")
foreach(SPIDER_TITLE IN LISTS SPIDER_TITLES)
  if(SPIDER_TITLE STREQUAL "spiderman1")
    include(cmake/spiderman_port.cmake)
  elseif(SPIDER_TITLE STREQUAL "spiderman2")
    include(titles/spiderman2/port.cmake)
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "unknown SPIDER_TITLES entry '${SPIDER_TITLE}'")
  endif()
endforeach()

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(face_builder_census_test
    tests/face_builder_census_test.cpp
    game/render/face_builder_census.cpp)
  target_include_directories(face_builder_census_test PRIVATE game/render)
  add_test(NAME face_builder_census COMMAND face_builder_census_test)
  add_executable(mesh_transform_contract_test
    tests/mesh_transform_contract_test.cpp
    game/render/mesh_transform.cpp)
  target_include_directories(mesh_transform_contract_test PRIVATE game/render)
  add_test(NAME mesh_transform_contract COMMAND mesh_transform_contract_test)
  add_executable(mesh_animated_vertex_test
    tests/mesh_animated_vertex_test.cpp
    game/render/mesh_animated_vertex.cpp
    game/render/mips_fixed_point.cpp)
  target_include_directories(mesh_animated_vertex_test PRIVATE game/render)
  add_test(NAME mesh_animated_vertex COMMAND mesh_animated_vertex_test)
  add_executable(mesh_pose_contract_test
    tests/mesh_pose_contract_test.cpp
    game/render/mesh_pose_contract.cpp
    game/render/mips_fixed_point.cpp)
  target_include_directories(mesh_pose_contract_test PRIVATE game/render)
  add_test(NAME mesh_pose_contract COMMAND mesh_pose_contract_test)
  add_executable(asset_upload_ledger_test
    tests/asset_upload_ledger_test.cpp
    game/render/asset_upload_ledger.cpp)
  target_include_directories(asset_upload_ledger_test PRIVATE game/render)
  add_test(NAME asset_upload_ledger COMMAND asset_upload_ledger_test)
  add_executable(mesh_asset_cook_test
    tests/mesh_asset_cook_test.cpp
    game/render/mesh_asset_cook.cpp)
  target_include_directories(mesh_asset_cook_test PRIVATE game/render)
  add_test(NAME mesh_asset_cook COMMAND mesh_asset_cook_test)
  add_executable(guest_frame_fallback_test
    tests/guest_frame_fallback_test.cpp
    game/render/guest_frame_fallback.cpp)
  target_include_directories(guest_frame_fallback_test PRIVATE
    game/render
    ${PSXPORT_DIR}/runtime/recomp)
  add_test(NAME guest_frame_fallback COMMAND guest_frame_fallback_test)
  add_executable(spider_runtime_test
    tests/spider_runtime_test.cpp
    game/core/spider_runtime.cpp
    game/core/game_config.cpp
    game/core/game_hooks.cpp
    titles/spiderman1/spider1_runtime.cpp
    game/core/spider_context.cpp
    game/core/allocator_audit.cpp)
  spider_read_title(spiderman1 SPIDER1_TEST)
  target_include_directories(spider_runtime_test PRIVATE
    game game/core game/render generated titles/spiderman1)
  target_compile_definitions(spider_runtime_test PRIVATE
    SPIDER_TITLE_SERIAL="${SPIDER1_TEST_SERIAL}"
    SPIDER_TITLE_DISC_ENV="${SPIDER1_TEST_DISCENV}"
    SPIDER_TITLE_GUEST_EXE="${SPIDER1_TEST_GUESTEXECUTABLE}"
    SPIDER_TITLE_EXECUTABLE_SIZE=${SPIDER1_TEST_FILESIZE}
    SPIDER_TITLE_EXECUTABLE_SHA256="${SPIDER1_TEST_EXECUTABLESHA256}")
  target_link_libraries(spider_runtime_test PRIVATE psxport)
  add_test(NAME spider_runtime COMMAND spider_runtime_test)
  add_executable(enter_electro_runtime_test
    tests/enter_electro_runtime_test.cpp
    game/core/spider_runtime.cpp
    titles/spiderman2/enter_electro_runtime.cpp)
  spider_read_title(spiderman2 SPIDER2_TEST)
  target_include_directories(enter_electro_runtime_test PRIVATE
    game game/core titles/spiderman2)
  target_compile_definitions(enter_electro_runtime_test PRIVATE
    SPIDER_TITLE_SERIAL="${SPIDER2_TEST_SERIAL}"
    SPIDER_TITLE_DISC_ENV="${SPIDER2_TEST_DISCENV}"
    SPIDER_TITLE_GUEST_EXE="${SPIDER2_TEST_GUESTEXECUTABLE}"
    SPIDER_TITLE_EXECUTABLE_SIZE=${SPIDER2_TEST_FILESIZE}
    SPIDER_TITLE_EXECUTABLE_SHA256="${SPIDER2_TEST_EXECUTABLESHA256}")
  target_link_libraries(enter_electro_runtime_test PRIVATE psxport)
  add_test(NAME enter_electro_runtime COMMAND enter_electro_runtime_test)
  add_executable(executable_identity_test
    tests/executable_identity_test.cpp
    game/core/executable_identity.cpp)
  target_include_directories(executable_identity_test PRIVATE game/core)
  target_link_libraries(executable_identity_test PRIVATE OpenSSL::Crypto)
  add_test(NAME executable_identity COMMAND executable_identity_test)
  add_test(NAME title_catalog COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/test_title_catalog.py)
  add_test(
    NAME re08_store_sites
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/test_re08_store_sites.py
  )
  add_test(
    NAME launcher_policy
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/run.py --selftest
  )
  add_test(
    NAME cpp_policy
    COMMAND
      ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${PSXPORT_DIR}/tools/check_cpp_style.py
      --root ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
      --compile-commands ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
  )
endif()
